4.1.1 addresses the implementation of the access control system:

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **4.1.1** | [MODIFIED] Verify that the application enforces access control rules at a trusted service layer and doesn't rely on controls which an untrusted user could manipulate such as client-side JavaScript. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 602 |

However, it is under section V4.1 - Access Control Design, which I believe is not the appropriate location. 

This may change depending on what we do with #2139

comments.body: This requirement belongs to access control design - if someone designed it to be on a not trusted service layer, such as client-side javascript code, it's an architecture issue.
Okay, I'm good with closing. Sorry
